gaps.fact: Priorat has significant diurnal shifts. Only the article mentions its cool nights; no chapter fact or stem.

Priorat's terrain does not allow mechanisation, and its bush vine (gobelet) training gives naturally low yields; the Court asks the candidate to recognise a photo of a bush vine. The chapter gives the old bush vines and tiny yields but never the absence of machines, and the Codex holds no picture of a gobelet vine (the teaching images cover bottles, service and the grid only).

Cava is usually riddled in the gyropalette, a Spanish invention, instead of by hand; and Priorat's modern winemaking uses French oak. The gyropalette appears only in Champagne stems, never tied to Cava or to Spain, and Priorat's French oak stands only in the article.
Garnacha Blanca as a Catalan white (Priorat's lead white grape). Only the priorat article names it; in the banks it is a wrong option in i-vj33s67n and i-y953im84.

Clos Erasmus, Clos Martinet and Gramona are never asked; Clos Mogador is only a distractor; Scala Dei is taught as the priory, not as the cellar the Court lists. The articles and producer entries hold them all but Clos Martinet, which the article gives as its house, Mas Martinet.
How Priorat's oak, ripeness, intensity and alcohol shape the pairing. One article line gives the dishes; no chapter fact or stem ties Priorat's weight and alcohol to food.

courtUpdates.now: Every wine of DO Penedès from the 2025 harvest on must be certified organic: the specification (INCAVI text, version of March 2026) applies the rule to still, sparkling, semi sparkling, liqueur and late harvest wines, making Penedès the first wine appellation that is wholly organic. Cava de Guarda Superior, which the Codex already teaches, is organic from the same harvest.
courtUpdates.source: DO Penedès plec de condicions, INCAVI, March 2026 (gencat.cat); vinetur.com, 20 August 2025; foodswinesfromspain.com, 18 December 2025.

Catalonia is well served for the Introductory column and for Cava law: the three grapes, the method, the nine and eighteen month tiers with the 2022 Guarda families and the zones, llicorella, the DOQ and Priorat's own ladder all have stems. The thin cells are the Certified viticulture (no machines, the gobelet photo), the gyropalette, Garnacha Blanca, four of the six producers and the pairing. Court cells to read with care: the Court puts Cava's high sites in the Pyrenees, while the Codex rightly places them in the Alt Penedès under Montserrat, in the pre coastal range; and the Court lists Gramona under Cava, though the house left DO Cava for the Corpinnat mark in 2019, as the penedes article and the producer entry say. The penedes article calls Clàssic Penedès organic by rule but not the whole DO, which is now the case (logged above); the article should gain that line. No errors found. One search spent, on DO Penedès. Card, fact and trap numbers count from one.
